top.headline: WARMINGTON: Suspect arrested and victim ID'd in fatal stabbing on TTC bus in Scarborough
top.what: Toronto police have arrested a man in connection with a deadly stabbing on a TTC bus in Scarborough on Thursday night. Nicholas Crawford, 40, of Toronto, turned himself in to police on Friday and was charged with second-degree murder.

top.headline: Russian ship docked in Libya hit in suspected drone attack
top.what: A Russian ship docked at a naval base in Benghazi was severely damaged in a suspected Ukrainian drone attack Sunday, according to Libyan officials. The Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, was struck by two sea drones while docked in the eastern Libyan port city, triggering an explosion and a fire.
